_: The MCP credential header rule, shared by crates/core/src/mcp.rs (the authority), assets/js/mcp.js and the desktop (desktop/src/feat/mcp.rs, desktop/screens/mcp.luau). A name is split into word parts at every character that is not a letter or a digit; it carries a credential when one part starts or ends with a word of `words`. Such a header's value must hold a well-formed ${name} placeholder. `message` is the refusal, NAME replaced by the header name as typed.
message: NAME carries a credential: write its value with a placeholder, such as `EXAMPLE`, and sbxw asks for the secret separately
